scope: Offline measured fixed-error choices. Eligibility requires BOTH original-input relative Frobenius and maximum per-column relative L2 error <= budget. Prepared/device choices use original B0 checkpoints; host choices require all four changing inputs. No deployable predictor or unseen-input error guarantee. Reuse estimates add separately measured one-time CPU format conversion/native plan setup and graph creation where applicable, not measured cold-process request distributions.
